summary: Report Koru doctor dependency and virtualenv drift to Planfile

delivery.outcome: Koru doctor detects competing project virtual environments, offers a read-only uv lock freshness check, and creates deduplicated Planfile tickets through the configured tracker synchronization.
nonGoals: Do not upgrade dependencies or mutate lockfiles and virtual environments.
Do not remove project virtual environments automatically.
Do not alter external tracker configuration beyond the existing configured Planfile synchronization.

architecture.decision: Keep default doctor execution local and read-only. Run uv only behind an explicit freshness flag, then hand persistent actionable findings to the existing Planfile task creator so configured remote integrations are stamped and synchronized.
architecture.rollback: Revert the protected merge; markers can be recreated on the next diagnostic run.

commands: PYTHONPATH=src python -m ruff check src/koru tests/test_doctor.py tests/test_doctor_dependency_diagnostics.py
validation.evidence: Focused unit tests, static analysis and repository governance validation.
